chunks: That you do not associate anything with Allah,
and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), so do not neglect his sunnah,
You will then be free from evil/blame.
ai.seo_question: What are the two pillars Imam Ali enjoins in his final will?
ai.summary: In this testament from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the dual foundations of Islamic orthodoxy: strict monotheism (Tawhid) and adherence to the Prophet’s Sunnah, metaphorically describing them as enduring pillars and illuminating lamps. This emphasis reflects the Shia scholarly view that the Prophet’s teachings and the Imam’s guidance are inseparable sources of divine truth, ensuring the community remains free from spiritual error (dhamm) through their preservation.

en.sayed-ali-raza: I enjoin upon you as my dying wish
not to regard anything by way of partner with Allāh,
not to disregard the sunnah of Muḥammad (may Allāh bless him and his descendants),
You will then be free from evil.
